strategy.name: Systematic Momentum Stock Picker
strategy.objective: Rank stocks by momentum strength, continuation probability, relative strength and risk-adjusted trend quality

indicators.label: 1-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last trading day. Captures overnight and intraday momentum.

indicators.label: 3-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last 3 trading days. Useful for spotting very short-term momentum bursts.

indicators.label: 5-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last 5 trading days. Measures short-term momentum direction and strength.

indicators.label: 10-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last 10 trading days. Captures two-week momentum trends.

indicators.label: 20-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last 20 trading days (~1 month). A key swing-trading momentum window.

indicators.label: 40-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last 40 trading days (~2 months). Captures medium-term trend moves.

indicators.label: 60-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last 60 trading days (~3 months). A standard quarterly momentum measure.

indicators.label: 120-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last 120 trading days (~6 months). Measures intermediate-term momentum.

indicators.label: 252-Day Return
indicators.description: Percentage price change over the last 252 trading days (~1 year). The classic annual momentum factor.

indicators.label: 252D Return ex-21D
indicators.description: 12-month return excluding the most recent month. Removes short-term reversal noise from the annual momentum signal.

indicators.label: Acceleration 5D vs 20D
indicators.description: Ratio of 5-day return to 20-day return. Values above 1 indicate momentum is accelerating in the short term.

indicators.label: Acceleration 10D vs 60D
indicators.description: Ratio of 10-day return to 60-day return. Detects whether recent momentum is speeding up relative to the longer trend.

indicators.label: Momentum Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's composite momentum score across all stocks in the universe. Higher means stronger momentum vs peers.

indicators.label: Return Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's return among all stocks. Shows where this stock stands in the cross-sectional return distribution.

categories.label: Relative Strength
categories.description: RS vs Nifty, sector, and peer group

indicators.label: RS vs Nifty 1D
indicators.description: Stock's 1-day return minus Nifty's 1-day return. Positive values mean the stock outperformed the market today.

indicators.label: RS vs Nifty 5D
indicators.description: Stock's 5-day return minus Nifty's 5-day return. Measures short-term outperformance vs the broad market.

indicators.label: RS vs Nifty 20D
indicators.description: Stock's 20-day return minus Nifty's 20-day return. Captures monthly relative outperformance vs the market.

indicators.label: RS vs Nifty 60D
indicators.description: Stock's 60-day return minus Nifty's 60-day return. Quarterly relative strength vs the broad index.

indicators.label: RS vs Nifty 120D
indicators.description: Stock's 120-day return minus Nifty's 120-day return. Half-year relative performance vs the market.

indicators.label: RS vs Sector 5D
indicators.description: Stock's 5-day return minus its sector's 5-day return. Identifies stocks leading within their sector.

indicators.label: RS vs Sector 20D
indicators.description: Stock's 20-day return minus its sector's 20-day return. Shows monthly outperformance within the sector.

indicators.label: RS vs Sector 60D
indicators.description: Stock's 60-day return minus its sector's 60-day return. Quarterly sector-relative strength.

indicators.label: RS vs Sector 120D
indicators.description: Stock's 120-day return minus its sector's 120-day return. Half-year sector-relative momentum.

indicators.label: RS vs Peer Group
indicators.description: Stock's return relative to its peer group average. Identifies the strongest names among direct competitors.

indicators.label: RS Ratio
indicators.description: Price of stock divided by price of Nifty, normalized. A rising RS ratio means the stock is outperforming the index.

indicators.label: RS Slope 5D
indicators.description: Slope of the RS ratio line over 5 days. Positive slope means relative strength is improving.

indicators.label: RS Slope 20D
indicators.description: Slope of the RS ratio line over 20 days. Shows the medium-term direction of relative outperformance.

indicators.label: RS Slope 60D
indicators.description: Slope of the RS ratio line over 60 days. Reveals the longer-term trajectory of relative strength.

indicators.label: RS Acceleration 5D
indicators.description: Change in RS slope over 5 days. Positive acceleration means relative strength is gaining speed.

indicators.label: RS Acceleration 20D
indicators.description: Change in RS slope over 20 days. Detects whether relative outperformance is speeding up or slowing down.

indicators.label: RS Breakout
indicators.description: True when the RS ratio breaks above its recent high. Signals that relative outperformance is reaching new levels.

indicators.label: RS New High
indicators.description: True when the RS ratio hits a new 52-week high. Strong signal of sustained leadership vs the market.

indicators.label: RS Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's relative strength among all stocks in the universe. Higher means stronger outperformance vs peers.

categories.label: Moving Averages
categories.description: SMA/EMA values, crossovers, slopes, and alignment

indicators.label: SMA 5
indicators.description: Simple moving average of closing prices over 5 days. Tracks very short-term price direction.

indicators.label: SMA 10
indicators.description: Simple moving average of closing prices over 10 days. A two-week trend reference level.

indicators.label: SMA 20
indicators.description: Simple moving average of closing prices over 20 days. Key short-term trend and mean-reversion reference.

indicators.label: SMA 50
indicators.description: Simple moving average of closing prices over 50 days. A widely watched intermediate trend line.

indicators.label: SMA 100
indicators.description: Simple moving average of closing prices over 100 days. Bridges short-term and long-term trend views.

indicators.label: SMA 200
indicators.description: Simple moving average of closing prices over 200 days. The primary long-term trend indicator; price above it signals a bull trend.

indicators.label: EMA 9
indicators.description: Exponential moving average over 9 periods. Reacts faster than SMA for quick trend signals.

indicators.label: EMA 20
indicators.description: Exponential moving average over 20 periods. A responsive short-term trend filter favored by swing traders.

indicators.label: EMA 50
indicators.description: Exponential moving average over 50 periods. Intermediate trend direction with faster response than SMA 50.

indicators.label: EMA 100
indicators.description: Exponential moving average over 100 periods. Smooths intermediate-term trend while remaining responsive.

indicators.label: EMA 200
indicators.description: Exponential moving average over 200 periods. Long-term trend direction with quicker reaction than SMA 200.

indicators.label: Price vs SMA20
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 20-day SMA. Measures short-term extension above or below the mean.

indicators.label: Price vs SMA50
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 50-day SMA. Shows how stretched the price is from the intermediate trend.

indicators.label: Price vs SMA100
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 100-day SMA. Gauges extension relative to the longer trend.

indicators.label: Price vs SMA200
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 200-day SMA. Large values indicate overextension from the long-term trend.

indicators.label: Price vs EMA20
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 20-day EMA. Measures short-term extension using an exponential baseline.

indicators.label: Price vs EMA50
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 50-day EMA. Shows how far price has deviated from the intermediate EMA.

indicators.label: SMA20 vs SMA50
indicators.description: Percentage gap between 20-day and 50-day SMA. Positive values confirm the short-term trend leads the intermediate trend.

indicators.label: SMA50 vs SMA200
indicators.description: Percentage gap between 50-day and 200-day SMA. Positive means a golden cross environment; negative means death cross.

indicators.label: EMA20 vs EMA50
indicators.description: Percentage gap between 20-day and 50-day EMA. A positive and widening gap signals strengthening trend.

indicators.label: EMA50 vs EMA200
indicators.description: Percentage gap between 50-day and 200-day EMA. Confirms the long-term trend direction with EMA sensitivity.

indicators.label: SMA20 Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the 20-day SMA. Positive slope confirms a rising short-term trend.

indicators.label: SMA50 Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the 50-day SMA. Positive slope confirms a rising intermediate-term trend.

indicators.label: SMA100 Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the 100-day SMA. Shows whether the longer trend is accelerating or flattening.

indicators.label: SMA200 Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the 200-day SMA. A positive slope confirms the primary long-term uptrend.

indicators.label: EMA20 Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the 20-day EMA. Responsive measure of short-term trend direction.

indicators.label: EMA50 Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the 50-day EMA. Shows intermediate trend momentum direction.

indicators.label: EMA200 Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the 200-day EMA. Confirms long-term trend direction using the exponential average.

indicators.label: MA Alignment Score
indicators.description: Composite score measuring how well all moving averages are stacked in bullish order. Higher scores indicate perfect bullish alignment (price > EMA20 > SMA50 > SMA200).
indicators.formula: Score based on: Price > EMA20 > SMA50 > SMA200 and all slopes positive

categories.label: Trend Structure
categories.description: Higher highs/lows, swing analysis, trend duration

indicators.label: Higher High Count
indicators.description: Number of successive higher swing highs in the recent price structure. More higher highs confirm a healthy uptrend.
indicators.formula: Count of swing highs where each > previous

indicators.label: Higher Low Count
indicators.description: Number of successive higher swing lows in the recent price structure. Higher lows are the backbone of an uptrend.
indicators.formula: Count of swing lows where each > previous

indicators.label: Lower High Count
indicators.description: Number of successive lower swing highs. Increasing count signals a forming downtrend.
indicators.formula: Count of swing highs where each < previous

indicators.label: Lower Low Count
indicators.description: Number of successive lower swing lows. A hallmark of a downtrend or distribution phase.
indicators.formula: Count of swing lows where each < previous

indicators.label: Swing High Strength
indicators.description: Magnitude of the last swing high relative to surrounding prices. Stronger swing highs indicate more conviction at turning points.

indicators.label: Swing Low Strength
indicators.description: Magnitude of the last swing low relative to surrounding prices. Stronger swing lows indicate solid buying support.

indicators.label: Trend Structure Score
indicators.description: Composite score combining higher highs, higher lows, and trend consistency. Higher values signal a well-defined uptrend.

indicators.label: Distance from Swing High
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price below the last swing high. Small values mean the stock is near its recent peak.

indicators.label: Distance from Swing Low
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price above the last swing low. Larger values mean a bigger bounce from the trough.

indicators.label: Consecutive Up Days
indicators.description: Number of consecutive trading days with positive close-to-close returns. Long streaks indicate strong buying pressure.
indicators.formula: Count of consecutive days where Close > Close[prev]

indicators.label: Consecutive Down Days
indicators.description: Number of consecutive trading days with negative close-to-close returns. Long streaks indicate selling pressure.
indicators.formula: Count of consecutive days where Close < Close[prev]

indicators.label: Trend Duration
indicators.description: Number of days the current trend (up or down) has persisted. Longer durations suggest a well-established trend.

indicators.label: Days Since Last High
indicators.description: Trading days elapsed since the most recent 52-week high. Lower values mean the stock is in active leadership.

indicators.label: Days Since Last Low
indicators.description: Trading days elapsed since the most recent 52-week low. Higher values suggest the stock has recovered from its trough.

categories.label: Breakout
categories.description: Price breakouts, strength, volume confirmation, follow-through

indicators.label: Distance from 20D High
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 20-day high. Near-zero values indicate the stock is testing its short-term peak.

indicators.label: Distance from 50D High
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 50-day high. Shows how far price is from the intermediate-term peak.

indicators.label: Distance from 100D High
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 100-day high. Measures proximity to the longer-term resistance.

indicators.label: Distance from 200D High
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the 200-day high. Values near zero signal the stock is challenging its long-term peak.

indicators.label: Distance from 52W High
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from its 52-week high. The classic measure of how close a stock is to its annual peak.

indicators.label: Distance from 20D Low
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price above the 20-day low. Larger values mean the stock has bounced significantly from its short-term trough.

indicators.label: Distance from 50D Low
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price above the 50-day low. Shows how far the stock has recovered from its intermediate-term floor.

indicators.label: 20D Breakout
indicators.description: True when today's close exceeds the highest high of the previous 20 trading days. Signals potential start of a new short-term uptrend.

indicators.label: 50D Breakout
indicators.description: True when today's close exceeds the highest high of the previous 50 trading days. A stronger breakout signal than 20D.

indicators.label: 52W Breakout
indicators.description: True when today's close exceeds the 52-week high. The strongest breakout signal, often marking major trend initiations.

indicators.label: Breakout %
indicators.description: How far price has exceeded the prior resistance level. Larger breakout percentages suggest stronger conviction.

indicators.label: Breakout Strength
indicators.description: Composite measure combining breakout distance, volume, and candle quality. Higher values indicate a more convincing breakout.

indicators.label: Breakout Volume Ratio
indicators.description: Volume on the breakout day divided by average volume. Values above 2 indicate strong volume confirmation of the breakout.

indicators.label: Breakout Close Strength
indicators.description: Position of the close within the breakout day's range. Closes near the high indicate buyers controlled the session.

indicators.label: Follow-Through 1D
indicators.description: Return on the day after a breakout. Positive follow-through validates the breakout's quality.

indicators.label: Follow-Through 3D
indicators.description: Cumulative return over 3 days after a breakout. Shows whether buyers remain committed post-breakout.

indicators.label: Follow-Through 5D
indicators.description: Cumulative return over 5 days after a breakout. Sustained follow-through confirms institutional interest.

indicators.label: Failure Rate
indicators.description: Percentage of recent breakouts that failed (price fell back below the breakout level). Lower failure rates indicate a more reliable stock.

indicators.label: False Breakout Count
indicators.description: Number of breakouts in the recent past that reversed within a few days. Frequent false breakouts warn of choppy, unreliable price action.
indicators.formula: Count of breakouts where Close fell below level within 5 days

indicators.label: Retest Success
indicators.description: Percentage of breakouts where price retested the breakout level and held. Higher rates indicate reliable support at the breakout zone.

indicators.label: Resistance Test Count
indicators.description: Number of times price has tested the current resistance level. More tests weaken resistance and increase breakout probability.
indicators.formula: Count of touches near the resistance level

indicators.label: Resistance Break Count
indicators.description: Number of resistance levels broken during the current trend. More breaks indicate persistent upward momentum.

indicators.label: Support Distance
indicators.description: Percentage distance from current price to the nearest support level. Larger values mean more downside risk before support.

categories.label: Volume
categories.description: Volume averages, ratios, trends, and relative volume

indicators.label: Volume 1D
indicators.description: Total shares traded today. Raw daily volume to gauge current interest in the stock.

indicators.label: Volume 5D Avg
indicators.description: Average daily volume over the last 5 trading days. Captures the very recent level of trading activity.

indicators.label: Volume 20D Avg
indicators.description: Average daily volume over the last 20 trading days. The standard baseline for measuring normal volume.

indicators.label: Volume 50D Avg
indicators.description: Average daily volume over the last 50 trading days. A smoothed baseline removing short-term volume spikes.

indicators.label: Volume Ratio 1D
indicators.description: Today's volume divided by the 20-day average. Values above 1 indicate above-average interest today.

indicators.label: Volume Ratio 5D
indicators.description: 5-day average volume divided by 20-day average. Sustained ratios above 1 suggest growing interest.

indicators.label: Volume Ratio 20D
indicators.description: 20-day average volume divided by 50-day average. Tracks whether volume is trending up over the medium term.

indicators.label: Volume Ratio 50D
indicators.description: 50-day average volume divided by 200-day average. Reveals long-term shifts in trading interest.

indicators.label: Up Volume
indicators.description: Sum of volume on days when the stock closed higher over the last 20 days. Shows buying-side volume commitment.

indicators.label: Down Volume
indicators.description: Sum of volume on days when the stock closed lower over the last 20 days. Shows selling-side volume commitment.

indicators.label: Up/Down Volume Ratio
indicators.description: Ratio of up-day volume to down-day volume. Values above 1 mean more volume flows in on up days, confirming bullish pressure.

indicators.label: Volume Trend
indicators.description: Slope of the volume moving average. Positive values mean volume is increasing over time, signaling growing interest.

indicators.label: Volume Slope
indicators.description: Short-term rate of change in daily volume. Captures whether volume is ramping up or fading.

indicators.label: RVOL
indicators.description: Relative volume: today's volume divided by the average volume for this time of day. Highlights unusual intraday activity.

indicators.label: Time-Adjusted RVOL
indicators.description: Relative volume adjusted for time elapsed in the trading session. More accurate than raw RVOL during market hours.

indicators.label: Volume Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's volume among all stocks in the universe. Compares this stock's activity to every other stock.

indicators.label: Volume Z-Score
indicators.description: Number of standard deviations today's volume is from its 20-day mean. Values above 2 indicate abnormally high volume.

indicators.label: Price Change × Volume Ratio
indicators.description: Product of price change percentage and volume ratio. High values mean a large move backed by heavy volume -- strong conviction.

indicators.label: Up Day High Volume
indicators.description: True when price closed up on above-average volume. Confirms that buyers are stepping in with conviction.

indicators.label: Up Day Low Volume
indicators.description: True when price closed up but on below-average volume. Suggests weak buying interest despite the positive close.

indicators.label: Down Day High Volume
indicators.description: True when price closed down on above-average volume. Indicates heavy selling pressure and potential distribution.

indicators.label: Down Day Low Volume
indicators.description: True when price closed down on below-average volume. Suggests the decline lacks conviction and may reverse.

indicators.label: Close Near Day High
indicators.description: Percentage position of the close relative to the day's high. Values near 100% mean buyers dominated through the close.

indicators.label: Close Near Day Low
indicators.description: Percentage proximity of the close to the day's low. Values near 100% mean sellers pushed the close to its lowest point.

indicators.label: Volume Price Trend
indicators.description: Cumulative sum of volume multiplied by price change percentage. Rising VPT confirms price trend is backed by volume.

indicators.label: Confirmation Score
indicators.description: Composite score measuring how well volume confirms recent price moves. Higher scores mean price action has strong volume support.

indicators.label: Avg Volume 20D
indicators.description: Average number of shares traded daily over 20 days. Used to ensure the stock has enough trading activity for entries and exits.

indicators.label: Avg Volume 50D
indicators.description: Average number of shares traded daily over 50 days. A smoothed measure of typical share trading activity.

indicators.label: Avg ₹ Volume 20D
indicators.description: Average daily rupee turnover over 20 days. Ensures the stock can absorb meaningful position sizes without moving the price.

indicators.label: Avg ₹ Volume 50D
indicators.description: Average daily rupee turnover over 50 days. A longer-window liquidity measure for position sizing.

indicators.label: Avg ₹ Volume 120D
indicators.description: Average daily rupee turnover over 120 days. Smooths out seasonal volume effects for a stable liquidity view.

indicators.label: Bid-Ask Spread
indicators.description: Absolute difference between the best bid and best ask price. Lower spread means cheaper execution for traders.

indicators.label: Bid-Ask Spread %
indicators.description: Bid-ask spread as a percentage of the mid price. A key cost metric; lower values indicate more liquid, cheaper-to-trade stocks.

indicators.label: Liquidity Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's liquidity among all stocks in the universe. Higher means easier to trade with less market impact.

indicators.label: Turnover Ratio
indicators.description: Daily volume divided by shares outstanding. Measures how actively the float is being traded; higher ratios indicate speculative interest.

indicators.label: ATR 14
indicators.description: Average True Range over 14 periods. Measures typical daily price movement in rupees, used for stop-loss placement and position sizing.

indicators.label: ATR 20
indicators.description: Average True Range over 20 periods. A smoother volatility measure aligned with the monthly trading cycle.

indicators.label: ATR 50
indicators.description: Average True Range over 50 periods. Long-term baseline volatility for setting wider stops and targets.

indicators.label: ATR %
indicators.description: ATR as a percentage of the current price. Normalizes volatility across stocks, enabling comparison between high- and low-priced names.

indicators.label: HV 5D
indicators.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over 5 days. Captures the most recent spike or calm in volatility.

indicators.label: HV 10D
indicators.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over 10 days. Bridges ultra-short and short-term volatility.

indicators.label: HV 20D
indicators.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over 20 days. The standard short-term volatility measure for options and risk management.

indicators.label: HV 60D
indicators.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over 60 days. Captures the typical quarterly volatility regime.

indicators.label: HV 120D
indicators.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over 120 days. A stable half-year volatility baseline.

indicators.label: Volatility Expansion
indicators.description: True when short-term volatility is significantly above its longer-term average. Signals increased risk and potential trend acceleration.

indicators.label: Volatility Contraction
indicators.description: True when short-term volatility is significantly below its longer-term average. Often precedes a breakout (squeeze setup).

indicators.label: ATR14 vs ATR50
indicators.description: Ratio of 14-day ATR to 50-day ATR. Values above 1 indicate expanding volatility; below 1 indicates contraction.

indicators.label: ATR Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the ATR over recent periods. Rising ATR slope warns of increasing volatility ahead.

indicators.label: Volatility Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's volatility among all stocks in the universe. Helps compare how volatile this stock is relative to peers.

indicators.label: Volatility Z-Score
indicators.description: Current volatility expressed as standard deviations from its own mean. Values above 2 indicate abnormally elevated volatility.

indicators.label: Relative Volatility
indicators.description: Stock's volatility divided by the market (Nifty) volatility. Values above 1 mean the stock is more volatile than the index.

indicators.label: Relative ATR
indicators.description: Stock's ATR percentage divided by the market ATR percentage. Normalizes volatility comparison vs the index.

indicators.label: Rel Vol Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of the stock's relative volatility across the universe. Shows where this stock's market-relative risk stands vs all peers.

indicators.label: BB Middle
indicators.description: Middle Bollinger Band, which is the 20-day simple moving average. Acts as the mean-reversion center for the bands.

indicators.label: BB Upper
indicators.description: Upper Bollinger Band, 2 standard deviations above the middle band. Price touching or exceeding it suggests overextension.

indicators.label: BB Lower
indicators.description: Lower Bollinger Band, 2 standard deviations below the middle band. Price touching it may signal oversold conditions.

indicators.label: BB Width
indicators.description: Width of the Bollinger Bands as a percentage of the middle band. Narrow width indicates low volatility (squeeze); wide indicates high volatility.

indicators.label: BB Width Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of current BB width in the stock's own history. Low percentiles signal a squeeze that often precedes a big move.

indicators.label: %B
indicators.description: Position of price within the Bollinger Bands, from 0 (lower band) to 1 (upper band). Values above 1 or below 0 indicate a breakout beyond the bands.

indicators.label: BB Squeeze
indicators.description: True when BB width is at a historically low level. Squeezes often precede explosive directional moves.

indicators.label: BB Expansion
indicators.description: True when BB width is expanding rapidly from a squeeze. Signals the start of a new trending move.
indicators.formula: BB_Width > 1.5 × BB_Width[5 days ago] AND BB_Squeeze[recent]

indicators.label: Above Upper Band
indicators.description: True when the close is above the upper Bollinger Band. In momentum, this signals trend strength rather than automatic reversal.

indicators.label: Below Lower Band
indicators.description: True when the close is below the lower Bollinger Band. Can signal oversold conditions or a breakdown.

indicators.label: Efficiency Ratio 10D
indicators.description: Net price change divided by the sum of absolute daily changes over 10 days. Values near 1 mean a clean, straight trend; near 0 means choppy.

indicators.label: Efficiency Ratio 20D
indicators.description: Net price change divided by the sum of absolute daily changes over 20 days. Measures how efficiently price moved in one direction.

indicators.label: Efficiency Ratio 50D
indicators.description: Net price change divided by the sum of absolute daily changes over 50 days. Long-window trend efficiency measure.

indicators.label: LR Slope 10D
indicators.description: Slope of the linear regression line fitted to the last 10 closing prices. Positive slope confirms an upward short-term trajectory.

indicators.label: LR Slope 20D
indicators.description: Slope of the linear regression line fitted to the last 20 closing prices. Shows the direction and steepness of the monthly trend.

indicators.label: LR Slope 50D
indicators.description: Slope of the linear regression line fitted to the last 50 closing prices. Captures intermediate trend direction and steepness.

indicators.label: LR R² 20D
indicators.description: R-squared of the 20-day linear regression. Values near 1 mean price follows a straight-line trend with minimal noise.

indicators.label: LR R² 50D
indicators.description: R-squared of the 50-day linear regression. High R² over 50 days signals a persistent, low-noise trend.

indicators.label: Trend T-Stat
indicators.description: T-statistic of the regression slope, measuring statistical significance of the trend. Values above 2 indicate a statistically significant trend.

indicators.label: Positive Days 5D
indicators.description: Count of days with positive returns out of the last 5. High counts suggest consistent buying pressure.

indicators.label: Positive Days 10D
indicators.description: Count of days with positive returns out of the last 10. Measures two-week trend consistency.

indicators.label: Positive Days 20D
indicators.description: Count of days with positive returns out of the last 20. Shows the proportion of winning days over a month.

indicators.label: Positive Days 50D
indicators.description: Count of days with positive returns out of the last 50. A broader measure of trend persistence.

indicators.label: Up Days Ratio 10D
indicators.description: Percentage of up days in the last 10 trading days. Values above 60% suggest bullish trend consistency.

indicators.label: Up Days Ratio 20D
indicators.description: Percentage of up days in the last 20 trading days. Measures monthly win rate of the stock.

indicators.label: Up Days Ratio 50D
indicators.description: Percentage of up days in the last 50 trading days. A broader consistency metric for the intermediate trend.

indicators.label: DD from 20D High
indicators.description: Percentage decline from the 20-day high. Shows current short-term pain level relative to recent peak.

indicators.label: DD from 50D High
indicators.description: Percentage decline from the 50-day high. Measures intermediate-term drawdown.

indicators.label: DD from 100D High
indicators.description: Percentage decline from the 100-day high. A broader drawdown measure for position management.

indicators.label: DD from 200D High
indicators.description: Percentage decline from the 200-day high. Shows the full extent of the long-term pullback.

indicators.label: DD from 52W High
indicators.description: Percentage decline from the 52-week high. The standard measure of how far a stock has fallen from its annual peak.

indicators.label: Max DD 20D
indicators.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline within the last 20 days. Measures worst-case short-term loss.
indicators.formula: Max peak-to-trough decline within last 20 days

indicators.label: Max DD 60D
indicators.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline within the last 60 days. Shows worst quarterly drawdown experience.
indicators.formula: Max peak-to-trough decline within last 60 days

indicators.label: Max DD 120D
indicators.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline within the last 120 days. Captures the worst half-year drawdown.
indicators.formula: Max peak-to-trough decline within last 120 days

indicators.label: Recovery from DD
indicators.description: Percentage recovery from the most recent drawdown trough. Shows how much of the loss has been recouped.

indicators.label: DD Duration
indicators.description: Number of trading days since the stock last made a new high. Longer durations indicate a struggling recovery.
indicators.formula: Days since last all-time or period high

indicators.label: Distance from EMA20
indicators.description: Percentage distance of price from the 20-day EMA. Traders use this to spot stocks pulling back to their short-term mean.

indicators.label: Distance from EMA50
indicators.description: Percentage distance of price from the 50-day EMA. Identifies pullbacks to the intermediate-term trend.

indicators.label: Pullback Depth
indicators.description: Maximum percentage decline from the recent swing high to the pullback low. Shallower pullbacks in uptrends are healthier.

indicators.label: Pullback Duration
indicators.description: Number of trading days from the swing high to the pullback low. Shorter pullback durations suggest eager buyers.

indicators.label: Recovery Speed
indicators.description: Rate at which price recovered from the pullback low, measured as return per day. Faster recovery indicates stronger demand.

indicators.label: PB Volume Contraction
indicators.description: Ratio of average volume during the pullback to volume during the prior advance. Low ratios (volume drying up) confirm a healthy pullback.
indicators.formula: Avg(Volume during pullback) / Avg(Volume during advance)

indicators.label: PB to ATR Ratio
indicators.description: Pullback depth divided by ATR. Normalizes pullback severity; values under 2 suggest a controlled, normal retracement.

indicators.label: PB Hold EMA20
indicators.description: True when the pullback low held above the 20-day EMA. Signals that the short-term trend support was respected.

indicators.label: PB Hold EMA50
indicators.description: True when the pullback low held above the 50-day EMA. Confirms the intermediate trend remains intact.

indicators.label: PB Recovery Strength
indicators.description: Composite score of recovery velocity, volume on recovery, and candle quality. Higher values mean a more convincing recovery from the pullback.

indicators.label: RSI 7
indicators.description: Relative Strength Index over 7 periods. A fast oscillator for short-term overbought/oversold signals.

indicators.label: RSI 14
indicators.description: Relative Strength Index over 14 periods. Values above 70 indicate overbought, below 30 oversold. Used to identify momentum extremes and potential reversals.

indicators.label: RSI 21
indicators.description: Relative Strength Index over 21 periods. A smoother RSI that filters out short-term noise for medium-term signals.

indicators.label: RSI Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the RSI. A rising RSI slope confirms accelerating momentum; falling slope warns of deceleration.

indicators.label: RSI Change 5D
indicators.description: Change in RSI over the last 5 days. Large positive changes indicate rapidly improving momentum.

indicators.label: RSI Change 10D
indicators.description: Change in RSI over the last 10 days. Tracks momentum shift over a two-week window.

indicators.label: RSI > 50
indicators.description: True when RSI is above 50, indicating bullish momentum. The simplest RSI trend filter.

indicators.label: RSI > 60
indicators.description: True when RSI is above 60, indicating moderately strong bullish momentum.

indicators.label: RSI > 70
indicators.description: True when RSI is above 70, the classic overbought threshold. In strong trends this signals strength, not reversal.

indicators.label: RSI Persist > 60
indicators.description: Consecutive days RSI has stayed above 60. Longer persistence confirms sustained strong momentum, typical in trending stocks.

indicators.label: RSI Persist > 70
indicators.description: Consecutive days RSI has stayed above 70. Extended persistence above 70 is characteristic of powerful trending moves.

indicators.label: RSI Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's RSI among all stocks in the universe. Shows relative momentum standing vs all peers.

indicators.label: MACD
indicators.description: Moving Average Convergence Divergence line. Positive MACD confirms short-term momentum exceeds longer-term momentum.

indicators.label: MACD Signal
indicators.description: 9-period EMA of the MACD line. Crossovers of MACD above its signal line generate buy signals.

indicators.label: MACD Histogram
indicators.description: Difference between MACD and its signal line. Positive and growing histogram confirms accelerating momentum.

indicators.label: MACD Hist Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of the MACD histogram. Tracks whether momentum acceleration is speeding up or slowing down.

indicators.label: MACD Hist Change
indicators.description: Change in MACD histogram from the prior bar. Positive changes mean momentum is accelerating.

indicators.label: MACD > 0
indicators.description: True when MACD is above zero, confirming that short-term trend momentum is bullish.

indicators.label: MACD Bull Crossover
indicators.description: True when MACD crosses above its signal line. A classic buy signal indicating momentum is turning positive.

indicators.label: ADX 14
indicators.description: Average Directional Index over 14 periods. Measures trend strength regardless of direction. Values above 25 indicate a strong trend.

indicators.label: ADX 20
indicators.description: Average Directional Index over 20 periods. A smoother trend strength measure with fewer false signals.

indicators.label: DI+
indicators.description: Positive Directional Indicator. Measures upward price movement strength. DI+ above DI- confirms bullish trend direction.

indicators.label: DI-
indicators.description: Negative Directional Indicator. Measures downward price movement strength. DI- above DI+ confirms bearish trend direction.

indicators.label: DI Difference
indicators.description: DI+ minus DI-. Positive values confirm bullish dominance; larger values mean stronger directional bias.

indicators.label: ADX Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of ADX. Rising ADX slope means the trend is gaining strength; falling means it is weakening.

categories.label: Price Action
categories.description: Candle analysis, body/wick ratios, close position

indicators.label: Body Size
indicators.description: Absolute difference between open and close as a percentage of the open. Larger bodies indicate stronger conviction in the day's direction.

indicators.label: Upper Wick
indicators.description: Length of the upper wick as a percentage of the candle range. Long upper wicks indicate rejection at higher prices.

indicators.label: Lower Wick
indicators.description: Length of the lower wick as a percentage of the candle range. Long lower wicks indicate buying support at lower prices.

indicators.label: Candle Range
indicators.description: Total high-to-low range of the candle in rupees. Measures the day's total price excursion.

indicators.label: Body to Range
indicators.description: Candle body size as a percentage of the total range. High values mean the body dominated the move (conviction); low values suggest indecision.

indicators.label: Close Position
indicators.description: Position of the close within the day's range. Values near 100% mean close at the high (bullish); near 0% at the low (bearish).

indicators.label: Pos Close Ratio 5D
indicators.description: Percentage of the last 5 days where close was in the upper half of the daily range. Measures short-term buying dominance.

indicators.label: Pos Close Ratio 10D
indicators.description: Percentage of the last 10 days where close was in the upper half of the range. Two-week buying dominance measure.

indicators.label: Pos Close Ratio 20D
indicators.description: Percentage of the last 20 days where close was in the upper half of the range. Monthly buying dominance measure.

indicators.label: Avg Body 5D
indicators.description: Average candle body size over the last 5 days. Increasing average body sizes signal growing conviction.

indicators.label: Avg Range 5D
indicators.description: Average daily high-low range over 5 days. A short-term measure of daily price volatility.

indicators.label: Avg Range 20D
indicators.description: Average daily high-low range over 20 days. The baseline for what constitutes a normal day's price movement.

indicators.label: Bullish Candle Ratio
indicators.description: Percentage of candles with close above open over the lookback period. Higher ratios confirm bullish price action dominance.

indicators.label: Bearish Candle Ratio
indicators.description: Percentage of candles with close below open over the lookback period. Higher ratios indicate persistent selling pressure.

indicators.label: Gap Up %
indicators.description: Today's gap-up size as a percentage. Calculated from prior close to today's open. Larger gaps signal overnight demand.

indicators.label: Gap Down %
indicators.description: Today's gap-down size as a percentage. Larger gap-downs signal overnight selling pressure or negative news.

indicators.label: Gap Frequency
indicators.description: Number of significant gaps (above a threshold) over the recent period. Frequent gaps indicate volatile, news-driven price action.
indicators.formula: Count of gaps > 1% in last 20 days

indicators.label: Gap Hold Rate
indicators.description: Percentage of gap-ups where the gap was not filled during the session. High hold rates suggest strong follow-through demand.

indicators.label: Gap Fill Rate
indicators.description: Percentage of gaps that were filled (price returned to prior close) during the session. High fill rates warn of weak gap conviction.

indicators.label: Gap Up High Volume
indicators.description: True when a gap-up occurred on above-average volume. Confirms institutional interest behind the gap.

indicators.label: Gap Up Close Near High
indicators.description: True when a gap-up day closed near its high. Shows buyers maintained control all day after the gap, a powerful momentum signal.

indicators.label: Gap vs ATR
indicators.description: Gap size normalized by ATR. Large values relative to ATR indicate an unusual, potentially significant overnight move.

indicators.label: Gap Volume Ratio
indicators.description: Volume on the gap day divided by average volume. Measures how much conviction accompanied the gap.

indicators.label: VWAP
indicators.description: Volume-Weighted Average Price for the session. The benchmark price where most volume traded; institutional traders use it to gauge execution quality.

indicators.label: Price vs VWAP
indicators.description: Percentage difference between current price and VWAP. Positive means price is above the volume-weighted mean (buyers in control).

indicators.label: VWAP Distance
indicators.description: Absolute percentage distance from VWAP. Larger values mean price has deviated significantly from the session's fair value.

indicators.label: VWAP Slope
indicators.description: Direction and steepness of the VWAP line. A rising VWAP confirms that buying volume is occurring at progressively higher prices.

indicators.label: Price Above VWAP
indicators.description: True when current price is above VWAP. Price holding above VWAP indicates bullish intraday sentiment.

indicators.label: Anchored VWAP 20D
indicators.description: VWAP anchored to the price 20 days ago. Shows the average cost basis of all trades over the last month.

indicators.label: Anchored VWAP 50D
indicators.description: VWAP anchored to the price 50 days ago. Reveals the intermediate-term average cost basis of participants.

indicators.label: AVWAP from Breakout
indicators.description: VWAP anchored to the most recent breakout date. Shows the average entry price of traders who entered at the breakout.
indicators.formula: Sum(Price × Volume, since breakout) / Sum(Volume, since breakout)

indicators.label: AVWAP from Swing Low
indicators.description: VWAP anchored to the last swing low. Represents the average cost basis since the uptrend began.
indicators.formula: Sum(Price × Volume, since swing low) / Sum(Volume, since swing low)

indicators.label: AVWAP Distance
indicators.description: Percentage distance from the anchored VWAP. Shows how far price has moved from the reference cost basis.

indicators.label: VWAP Reclaim
indicators.description: True when price reclaims VWAP after being below it. A bullish signal as buyers regain control of the volume-weighted mean.

indicators.label: VWAP Rejection
indicators.description: True when price tests VWAP from below and gets rejected. Bearish signal confirming VWAP as overhead resistance.

categories.label: Money Flow
categories.description: OBV, CMF, MFI, A/D line, force index

indicators.label: OBV
indicators.description: On-Balance Volume: cumulative sum of volume on up days minus volume on down days. Rising OBV confirms price trend; divergences warn of reversal.
indicators.formula: Cumulative: +Volume if Close > Close[prev], -Volume if Close < Close[prev]

indicators.label: OBV Slope
indicators.description: Short-term rate of change of OBV. Positive slope confirms money is flowing into the stock.

indicators.label: OBV 20D Slope
indicators.description: 20-day slope of OBV. A positive and sustained slope confirms consistent accumulation over the past month.

indicators.label: CMF 20
indicators.description: Chaikin Money Flow over 20 periods. Positive values indicate buying pressure; negative indicates selling pressure over the past month.

indicators.label: CMF 50
indicators.description: Chaikin Money Flow over 50 periods. A smoother measure of institutional accumulation or distribution.

indicators.label: MFI 14
indicators.description: Money Flow Index over 14 periods. Like RSI but volume-weighted. Above 80 is overbought; below 20 is oversold.

indicators.label: MFI Slope
indicators.description: Rate of change of MFI. Rising slope means money flow momentum is improving.

indicators.label: A/D Line
indicators.description: Accumulation/Distribution line: cumulative indicator based on close location within the range and volume. Tracks whether volume flows into (accumulation) or out of (distribution) a stock.

indicators.label: A/D Line Slope
indicators.description: Slope of the A/D line. Positive slope confirms accumulation; negative confirms distribution.

indicators.label: Force Index
indicators.description: Measures the force behind price moves using price change and volume. Large positive values confirm strong buying power.

indicators.label: Ease of Movement
indicators.description: Measures how easily price moves relative to volume. High positive values mean price advances effortlessly on low volume.

indicators.label: Volume Price Trend
indicators.description: Cumulative indicator that adds a portion of volume based on the direction and magnitude of the price change. Confirms whether volume supports the price direction.

indicators.label: Volume Profile
indicators.description: Volume distribution across price levels. Shows where the most trading activity occurred, revealing important support and resistance zones.
indicators.formula: Volume at each price level over lookback period

indicators.label: POC
indicators.description: Price level with the highest traded volume (Point of Control). Acts as a magnet for price and key support/resistance.
indicators.formula: Price level with Max(Volume) in the profile

indicators.label: Price vs POC
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from the Point of Control. Shows proximity to the highest-volume price level.

indicators.label: HVN Distance
indicators.description: Percentage distance from the nearest high-volume node. HVNs act as support/resistance where price tends to consolidate.

indicators.label: LVN Distance
indicators.description: Percentage distance from the nearest low-volume node. LVNs are zones price moves through quickly -- potential breakout/breakdown areas.

indicators.label: Volume Concentration
indicators.description: Measures how concentrated volume is around the POC. High concentration means a tight value area; low means dispersed trading.

indicators.label: Volume Dist Skew
indicators.description: Skewness of the volume distribution across price levels. Positive skew means more volume at lower prices (accumulation); negative means distribution at highs.

indicators.label: Return Z-Score 5D
indicators.description: 5-day return expressed in standard deviations from its historical mean. Values above 2 indicate statistically unusual positive returns.

indicators.label: Return Z-Score 20D
indicators.description: 20-day return expressed in standard deviations from its historical mean. Identifies statistically significant monthly moves.

indicators.label: Return Z-Score 60D
indicators.description: 60-day return expressed in standard deviations from its historical mean. Flags abnormally large quarterly moves.

indicators.label: Price Z-Score 20D
indicators.description: Current price expressed as standard deviations from the 20-day mean. Shows how extended price is from its short-term average.

indicators.label: Price Z-Score 50D
indicators.description: Current price expressed as standard deviations from the 50-day mean. Measures extension from the intermediate-term mean.

indicators.label: Volume Z-Score
indicators.description: Current volume expressed as standard deviations from its historical mean. Detects statistically unusual volume activity.

indicators.label: Momentum Z-Score
indicators.description: Composite momentum score expressed in standard deviations. Highlights stocks with statistically extreme momentum readings.

indicators.label: Return Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of the current return within the stock's own return history. 95th percentile means the current return is higher than 95% of historical observations.

indicators.label: Momentum Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of the current momentum score within the stock's own history. Shows whether current momentum is historically strong or weak for this stock.

indicators.label: Volatility Z-Score
indicators.description: Current volatility expressed in standard deviations from its own historical mean. Values above 2 mean the stock is unusually volatile.

indicators.label: Autocorrelation 5D
indicators.description: Correlation between daily returns and their lagged values over 5 days. Positive values mean returns tend to persist (momentum); negative means they reverse.

indicators.label: Autocorrelation 10D
indicators.description: Correlation between daily returns and their lagged values over 10 days. Captures two-week return persistence patterns.

indicators.label: Autocorrelation 20D
indicators.description: Correlation between daily returns and their lagged values over 20 days. Higher positive values indicate a trending, momentum-friendly stock.

indicators.label: Sign Autocorrelation
indicators.description: Correlation of the sign (+1/-1) of returns with the prior day's sign. Measures whether up/down streaks persist more than random.

indicators.label: Distance from Mean
indicators.description: Percentage distance of price from its rolling mean. Large positive values warn the stock may be overextended and due for a pullback.

indicators.label: SMA20 Z-Score
indicators.description: Distance from SMA20 expressed in standard deviations. Values above 2 indicate the stock is statistically overextended above its 20-day mean.

indicators.label: SMA50 Z-Score
indicators.description: Distance from SMA50 expressed in standard deviations. Measures medium-term extension risk relative to the 50-day mean.

indicators.label: EMA20 Z-Score
indicators.description: Distance from EMA20 expressed in standard deviations. Uses exponential average for a more responsive extension measure.

indicators.label: RSI Extreme
indicators.description: True when RSI is in extreme territory (above 80 or below 20). Warns of heightened mean-reversion risk at momentum extremes.

indicators.label: Extension Score
indicators.description: Composite measure of how overextended the stock is, combining price distance from averages, RSI, and Bollinger Band position. Higher scores mean greater pullback risk.

indicators.label: Mean Reversion Risk
indicators.description: Overall risk score for mean reversion. Higher values warn that the current price level is unsustainable and a pullback is likely.
indicators.formula: Composite of extension metrics, duration at extremes, and historical reversion rates

indicators.label: Nifty Return 1D
indicators.description: Nifty 50 index return over 1 day. Sets the market context for the trading session.

indicators.label: Nifty Return 5D
indicators.description: Nifty 50 index return over 5 days. Captures the weekly market momentum.

indicators.label: Nifty Return 20D
indicators.description: Nifty 50 index return over 20 days. Monthly market trend context for stock selection.

indicators.label: Nifty Return 50D
indicators.description: Nifty 50 index return over 50 days. Intermediate-term market momentum for regime assessment.

indicators.label: Nifty Return 200D
indicators.description: Nifty 50 index return over 200 days. Long-term market trend that defines the primary bull/bear regime.

indicators.label: Nifty > SMA20
indicators.description: True when Nifty is above its 20-day SMA. Confirms the short-term market trend is bullish.

indicators.label: Nifty > SMA50
indicators.description: True when Nifty is above its 50-day SMA. Confirms the intermediate market trend is bullish.

indicators.label: Nifty > SMA200
indicators.description: True when Nifty is above its 200-day SMA. The primary long-term bull market indicator.

indicators.label: Nifty SMA20 Slope
indicators.description: Slope of Nifty's 20-day SMA. Positive slope confirms the short-term market trend is rising.

indicators.label: Nifty SMA50 Slope
indicators.description: Slope of Nifty's 50-day SMA. Positive slope confirms the intermediate market trend is rising.

indicators.label: Nifty SMA200 Slope
indicators.description: Slope of Nifty's 200-day SMA. Positive slope confirms the primary long-term market uptrend.

indicators.label: Nifty ADX
indicators.description: ADX of the Nifty 50 index. Measures the strength of the current market trend regardless of direction. Above 25 indicates a strong market trend.

indicators.label: Nifty ATR
indicators.description: Average True Range of the Nifty 50 index. Measures market-level volatility for regime classification.

indicators.label: Nifty Volatility
indicators.description: Annualized historical volatility of the Nifty 50. High values indicate a volatile market regime where different strategies may be needed.

indicators.label: Market Regime
indicators.description: Categorical market regime classification. Determines which stock selection and risk parameters to apply.
indicators.formula: Based on Nifty trend, SMA positions, ADX, and volatility thresholds

indicators.label: A/D Ratio
indicators.description: Number of advancing stocks divided by declining stocks. Values above 1 indicate broad market participation in an uptrend.

indicators.label: A/D Line
indicators.description: Cumulative sum of (advances minus declines). A rising A/D line confirms that market breadth supports the index move.

indicators.label: Market Breadth
indicators.description: Composite market breadth score combining A/D, new highs/lows, and stocks above key averages. Higher scores indicate a healthier market environment.

indicators.label: Stocks > SMA20
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks in the universe trading above their 20-day SMA. Measures short-term market breadth participation.

indicators.label: Stocks > SMA50
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks trading above their 50-day SMA. A key intermediate-term breadth indicator.

indicators.label: Stocks > SMA200
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks trading above their 200-day SMA. The primary long-term breadth indicator; readings below 50% signal a weak market.

indicators.label: New Highs
indicators.description: Number of stocks making new 52-week highs today. Rising new highs confirm a healthy, leadership-driven market.

indicators.label: New Lows
indicators.description: Number of stocks making new 52-week lows today. Rising new lows warn of broad weakness beneath the surface.

indicators.label: NH/NL Ratio
indicators.description: Ratio of new highs to new lows. Values well above 1 indicate a bull market; values below 1 indicate a bear market.

indicators.label: 52W High %
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks at or near their 52-week high. High readings confirm a strong market with many leaders.

indicators.label: 52W Low %
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks at or near their 52-week low. High readings signal broad weakness and risk-off conditions.

indicators.label: Momentum Breadth
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks with positive momentum scores. Measures how broadly momentum is distributed across the market.

indicators.label: Sector Return 1D
indicators.description: The stock's sector return over 1 day. Provides context for whether sector-level flows are supporting or dragging the stock.

indicators.label: Sector Return 5D
indicators.description: The stock's sector return over 5 days. Weekly sector momentum affects individual stock behavior.

indicators.label: Sector Return 20D
indicators.description: The stock's sector return over 20 days. Monthly sector momentum is a key driver of stock selection.

indicators.label: Sector Return 60D
indicators.description: The stock's sector return over 60 days. Quarterly sector performance for identifying sector rotation.

indicators.label: Sector Return 120D
indicators.description: The stock's sector return over 120 days. Half-year sector trend for identifying persistent sector leadership.

indicators.label: Sector RS
indicators.description: Sector return relative to the overall market. Positive values mean the sector is outperforming Nifty.

indicators.label: Sector Rank
indicators.description: Rank of this stock's sector among all sectors by momentum. Rank 1 is the strongest sector.

indicators.label: Sector Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this sector's momentum among all sectors. Higher means the sector is outperforming most others.

indicators.label: Sector Momentum Score
indicators.description: Composite momentum score for the sector, combining multi-timeframe returns and relative strength. Used to tilt toward stocks in leading sectors.

indicators.label: Sector Breadth
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks within the sector that are in uptrends. High breadth means the sector rally is broad-based, not driven by a few names.

indicators.label: Sector A/D
indicators.description: Advancing minus declining stocks within the sector. Positive values confirm broad sector participation.

indicators.label: Sector > SMA20
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks in the sector above their 20-day SMA. Measures short-term sector breadth health.

indicators.label: Sector > SMA50
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks in the sector above their 50-day SMA. Intermediate-term sector breadth measure.

indicators.label: Sector > SMA200
indicators.description: Percentage of stocks in the sector above their 200-day SMA. Long-term sector health indicator.

indicators.label: Sector New Highs
indicators.description: Number of stocks in the sector making new 52-week highs. More new highs confirm sector leadership.
indicators.formula: Count of sector stocks at 52-week highs

indicators.label: Sector New Lows
indicators.description: Number of stocks in the sector making new 52-week lows. Rising new lows warn of sector-wide weakness.
indicators.formula: Count of sector stocks at 52-week lows

indicators.label: Sector Mom Breadth
indicators.description: Percentage of sector stocks with positive momentum scores. A broad measure of momentum participation within the sector.

categories.label: Peer Momentum
categories.description: Rank and percentile within peer group

indicators.label: Peer Return 5D
indicators.description: Average 5-day return of the stock's peer group. Provides context for whether the peer group is strong or weak.

indicators.label: Peer Return 20D
indicators.description: Average 20-day return of the stock's peer group. Monthly peer performance for contextualizing the stock's move.

indicators.label: Peer Return 60D
indicators.description: Average 60-day return of the stock's peer group. Quarterly peer momentum for identifying group-level trends.

indicators.label: Peer Rank
indicators.description: This stock's rank within its peer group by momentum. Rank 1 is the strongest stock among its direct peers.

indicators.label: Peer Percentile
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's momentum within its peer group. Shows whether this stock leads or lags its direct competitors.

indicators.label: Peer Momentum Score
indicators.description: Composite momentum score averaged across the peer group. Identifies whether the stock is in a strong or weak peer cohort.

indicators.label: Open to Current
indicators.description: Return from today's open to the current price. Shows intraday momentum direction and strength.

indicators.label: High-Low Position
indicators.description: Current price position within today's range. Values near 100% mean price is at the day's high (bullish); near 0% at the low.

indicators.label: VWAP Distance
indicators.description: Percentage distance of current price from today's VWAP. Shows intraday positioning relative to average execution price.

indicators.label: VWAP Slope
indicators.description: Slope of the intraday VWAP line. Rising slope means the session's volume-weighted price is climbing.

indicators.label: First 15min Return
indicators.description: Return during the first 15 minutes of trading. The opening move often sets the tone for the session.

indicators.label: First 30min Return
indicators.description: Return during the first 30 minutes of trading. Captures the initial price discovery phase.

indicators.label: First Hour Return
indicators.description: Return during the first hour of trading. The first hour typically captures the highest volume and strongest directional moves.

indicators.label: Intraday Vol vs Avg
indicators.description: Current session volume relative to the average volume at this time of day. Detects unusual intraday activity.

indicators.label: Intraday RS Nifty
indicators.description: Stock's intraday return minus Nifty's intraday return. Shows real-time relative outperformance vs the market.

indicators.label: Intraday RS Sector
indicators.description: Stock's intraday return minus its sector's intraday return. Real-time sector-relative performance.

indicators.label: Intraday RS Slope
indicators.description: Slope of the intraday relative strength line. Rising slope means the stock is progressively outperforming during the session.

indicators.label: Intraday High Breakout
indicators.description: True when the stock breaks above its prior session's high during the current session. An intraday momentum signal.

indicators.label: Intraday Low Breakdown
indicators.description: True when the stock breaks below its prior session's low. A bearish intraday signal.

indicators.label: ORB
indicators.description: True when price breaks above the opening range (first 15/30 min high). A popular intraday breakout strategy trigger.

indicators.label: ORB Volume
indicators.description: Volume at the time of the opening range breakout. Higher volume confirms the breakout's reliability.

indicators.label: OR High Break
indicators.description: True when price breaks above the opening range high. Bullish intraday signal.

indicators.label: OR Low Break
indicators.description: True when price breaks below the opening range low. Bearish intraday signal.

indicators.label: Sharpe 20D
indicators.description: Annualized Sharpe ratio over 20 days. Measures return per unit of total risk. Higher values mean better risk-adjusted momentum.

indicators.label: Sharpe 60D
indicators.description: Annualized Sharpe ratio over 60 days. A quarterly risk-adjusted performance measure.

indicators.label: Sharpe 120D
indicators.description: Annualized Sharpe ratio over 120 days. A half-year risk-adjusted return that smooths short-term noise.

indicators.label: Sortino 20D
indicators.description: Annualized Sortino ratio over 20 days. Like Sharpe but only penalizes downside volatility, better for momentum stocks that spike upward.

indicators.label: Sortino 60D
indicators.description: Annualized Sortino ratio over 60 days. Quarterly downside-risk-adjusted performance measure.

indicators.label: Sortino 120D
indicators.description: Annualized Sortino ratio over 120 days. Half-year performance adjusted for downside risk only.

indicators.label: Return / Volatility
indicators.description: Simple ratio of total return to annualized volatility. Quick gauge of whether the return justifies the risk taken.

indicators.label: Return / Drawdown
indicators.description: Total return divided by maximum drawdown. Higher values mean the stock delivered good returns relative to its worst loss. Also called the Calmar-like ratio.

indicators.label: Mean Daily Return
indicators.description: Average daily return over the lookback period. The expected daily gain or loss based on recent history.

indicators.label: Median Daily Return
indicators.description: Median daily return over the lookback period. Less sensitive to outliers than the mean, showing the typical day's return.

indicators.label: Std Daily Return
indicators.description: Standard deviation of daily returns. Measures the dispersion of daily returns around the mean.

indicators.label: Skewness
indicators.description: Skewness of the return distribution. Positive skew means occasional large gains; negative skew means occasional large losses.

indicators.label: Kurtosis
indicators.description: Kurtosis of the return distribution. Higher kurtosis means fatter tails -- more frequent extreme moves than a normal distribution.

indicators.label: Best Day
indicators.description: Largest single-day gain in the lookback period. Shows the upside tail risk/opportunity for this stock.

indicators.label: Worst Day
indicators.description: Largest single-day loss in the lookback period. Shows the downside tail risk for position sizing and stop-loss decisions.

indicators.label: Large Positive Days
indicators.description: Count of days with returns exceeding 2 standard deviations above the mean. Frequent large up days signal momentum bursts.

indicators.label: Large Negative Days
indicators.description: Count of days with returns worse than 2 standard deviations below the mean. Frequent large down days signal unstable price action.

indicators.label: Beta 20D
indicators.description: Beta relative to Nifty over 20 days. Measures short-term sensitivity to market moves. Beta > 1 means the stock amplifies market moves.

indicators.label: Beta 60D
indicators.description: Beta relative to Nifty over 60 days. Quarterly market sensitivity measure.

indicators.label: Beta 120D
indicators.description: Beta relative to Nifty over 120 days. Half-year market sensitivity, more stable than shorter windows.

indicators.label: Beta 252D
indicators.description: Beta relative to Nifty over 252 days (1 year). The standard annual beta used for portfolio risk management.

indicators.label: Rolling Beta
indicators.description: Beta calculated on a rolling window. Tracks how the stock's market sensitivity is changing over time.

indicators.label: Upside Beta
indicators.description: Beta calculated only on days when Nifty is up. Higher upside beta means the stock captures more of the market's gains.
indicators.formula: Covariance(Stock, Nifty, on Nifty up days) / Variance(Nifty, up days)

indicators.label: Downside Beta
indicators.description: Beta calculated only on days when Nifty is down. Lower downside beta means the stock falls less when the market drops.
indicators.formula: Covariance(Stock, Nifty, on Nifty down days) / Variance(Nifty, down days)

indicators.label: Corr Nifty 20D
indicators.description: Correlation of stock returns with Nifty over 20 days. Shows how tightly the stock tracks the market short-term.

indicators.label: Corr Nifty 60D
indicators.description: Correlation of stock returns with Nifty over 60 days. Quarterly market co-movement measure.

indicators.label: Corr Sector 20D
indicators.description: Correlation of stock returns with its sector over 20 days. Shows whether the stock moves with or independent of its sector.

indicators.label: Corr Sector 60D
indicators.description: Correlation of stock returns with its sector over 60 days. Longer-window sector co-movement.

indicators.label: Corr Peer Group
indicators.description: Average correlation of the stock with its peer group stocks. Low correlation means the stock moves independently of its peers.

categories.label: Derivatives
categories.description: OI, futures basis, options IV, put-call ratio

indicators.label: Open Interest
indicators.description: Total outstanding futures/options contracts. Requires derivatives data. Rising OI with rising price confirms new longs entering.

indicators.label: OI Change
indicators.description: Change in open interest from the prior session. Requires derivatives data. Positive change with price rise signals long buildup.

indicators.label: OI Change %
indicators.description: Percentage change in open interest. Requires derivatives data. Large percentage increases indicate strong new positioning.

indicators.label: Volume/OI Ratio
indicators.description: Derivatives volume divided by open interest. Requires derivatives data. High ratios suggest active trading relative to existing positions.

indicators.label: Price-OI Relationship
indicators.description: Categorical label describing the price-OI combination (long buildup, short buildup, long unwinding, short covering). Requires derivatives data.
indicators.formula: Based on Price direction × OI direction

indicators.label: Futures Basis
indicators.description: Difference between futures price and spot price. Requires derivatives data. Positive basis (premium) indicates bullish expectations.

indicators.label: Futures Premium/Discount
indicators.description: Futures basis as a percentage of spot price. Requires derivatives data. Expanding premium suggests growing bullish consensus.

indicators.label: Put-Call Ratio
indicators.description: Ratio of put volume/OI to call volume/OI. Requires derivatives data. High PCR indicates bearish sentiment (contrarian bullish); low PCR indicates bullish sentiment.

indicators.label: Implied Volatility
indicators.description: Options-implied volatility. Requires derivatives data. Shows the market's expectation of future price movement magnitude.
indicators.formula: Derived from option prices using Black-Scholes

indicators.label: IV Percentile
indicators.description: Current IV ranked against the stock's own IV history. Requires derivatives data. Low IV percentile means options are cheap (squeeze setup).

indicators.label: IV Change
indicators.description: Change in implied volatility from the prior session. Requires derivatives data. Rising IV indicates increasing uncertainty or event anticipation.

indicators.label: Call OI Change
indicators.description: Change in call option open interest. Requires derivatives data. Rising call OI indicates new bullish bets.

indicators.label: Put OI Change
indicators.description: Change in put option open interest. Requires derivatives data. Rising put OI indicates new bearish bets or hedging.

indicators.label: Call/Put OI Ratio
indicators.description: Ratio of call OI to put OI. Requires derivatives data. Rising ratio suggests growing bullish positioning.

indicators.label: Max Pain
indicators.description: Price level where options writers have minimum loss. Requires derivatives data. Price tends to gravitate toward max pain near expiry.
indicators.formula: Price that minimizes total option buyer payoff

indicators.label: Option Volume
indicators.description: Total options contracts traded today. Requires derivatives data. Unusually high option volume can precede big stock moves.

indicators.label: Option OI Concentration
indicators.description: Concentration of OI at specific strike prices. Requires derivatives data. High concentration at a strike creates a support/resistance magnet.
indicators.formula: Max(OI at any strike) / Total OI

indicators.label: Delivery Quantity
indicators.description: Number of shares that resulted in actual delivery (settlement). Requires NSE delivery data. High delivery indicates genuine buying interest, not just speculation.

indicators.label: Delivery %
indicators.description: Percentage of traded volume that resulted in delivery. Requires NSE delivery data. Higher percentages suggest institutional or investor-driven buying.

indicators.label: Delivery vs 20D Avg
indicators.description: Today's delivery quantity relative to its 20-day average. Requires NSE delivery data. Values above 1 indicate unusually high conviction buying.

indicators.label: Delivery Trend
indicators.description: Slope of the delivery percentage over recent sessions. Requires NSE delivery data. Rising delivery trend confirms growing real demand.

indicators.label: Delivery Price Confirm
indicators.description: True when price is rising alongside rising delivery percentage. Requires NSE delivery data. Confirms that the price advance is driven by genuine buying.

indicators.label: News Count 24H
indicators.description: Number of news articles about the stock in the last 24 hours. Requires external news data. Sudden spikes may precede or accompany price moves.
indicators.formula: Count of news articles in last 24 hours

indicators.label: News Count 7D
indicators.description: Number of news articles about the stock in the last 7 days. Requires external news data. Sustained news flow indicates the stock is in the spotlight.
indicators.formula: Count of news articles in last 7 days

indicators.label: Positive News Ratio
indicators.description: Percentage of recent news with positive sentiment. Requires external news/sentiment data. Higher ratios suggest a favorable narrative.

indicators.label: Negative News Ratio
indicators.description: Percentage of recent news with negative sentiment. Requires external news/sentiment data. Higher ratios warn of developing negative narratives.

indicators.label: Sentiment Score
indicators.description: Composite sentiment score from news and social media. Requires external sentiment data. Positive values indicate bullish sentiment; negative indicates bearish.

indicators.label: Earnings Days Away
indicators.description: Trading days until the next earnings announcement. Requires corporate events data. Approaching earnings may increase volatility and require position adjustments.

indicators.label: Recent Earnings
indicators.description: True if earnings were reported within the last 5 trading days. Requires corporate events data. Post-earnings drift can drive momentum for several days.

indicators.label: Earnings Surprise
indicators.description: Percentage by which actual earnings exceeded or missed consensus estimates. Requires earnings data. Positive surprises tend to drive post-earnings momentum.

categories.label: Tradability Filters
categories.description: Market cap, price, circuit, ASM/GSM, F&O availability

indicators.label: Market Cap
indicators.description: Total market capitalization of the company in crores. Used to filter for stocks of sufficient size and institutional interest.

indicators.label: Price
indicators.description: Current stock price. Used to exclude penny stocks or very high-priced stocks based on trading preferences.

indicators.label: Avg ₹ Volume
indicators.description: Average daily rupee turnover used as a tradability filter. Ensures the stock has sufficient liquidity for meaningful position sizes.

indicators.label: Bid-Ask Spread
indicators.description: Bid-ask spread percentage used as a tradability filter. Wide spreads increase execution costs, especially for frequent traders.

indicators.label: ATR %
indicators.description: ATR percentage used as a tradability filter. Extremely high ATR% stocks may be too volatile for systematic strategies.

indicators.label: Circuit Status
indicators.description: Current circuit limit status of the stock. Stocks at upper/lower circuit limits cannot be freely traded and should be excluded.

indicators.label: Upper Circuit Distance
indicators.description: Percentage distance from the upper circuit limit. Very close values mean the stock may hit the limit and become untradable.

indicators.label: Lower Circuit Distance
indicators.description: Percentage distance from the lower circuit limit. Helps assess the maximum possible loss in a session.

indicators.label: ASM Status
indicators.description: True if the stock is under Additional Surveillance Measure. ASM stocks have trading restrictions and higher margins; typically excluded from systematic strategies.

indicators.label: GSM Status
indicators.description: True if the stock is under Graded Surveillance Measure. GSM stocks face progressively stricter trading restrictions and should be avoided.

indicators.label: F&O Available
indicators.description: True if the stock has futures and options available. F&O availability enables hedging and usually indicates higher institutional quality.

indicators.label: Return 5D Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's 5-day return among all stocks in the universe. Shows short-term return standing vs all peers.

indicators.label: Return 20D Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's 20-day return among all stocks in the universe. Monthly return standing vs all peers.

indicators.label: Return 60D Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's 60-day return among all stocks in the universe. Quarterly return standing vs all peers.

indicators.label: Return 120D Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's 120-day return among all stocks in the universe. Half-year return standing vs all peers.

indicators.label: RS Pctl
