indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's relative strength score among all stocks. Shows where it stands in the cross-sectional RS distribution.

indicators.label: Volume Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's volume among all stocks. Shows relative trading activity vs the entire universe.

indicators.label: Breakout Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's breakout strength score among all stocks. Identifies the most decisive breakouts in the universe.

indicators.label: Trend Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's trend quality score among all stocks. Shows which stocks have the cleanest, most persistent trends.

indicators.label: Volatility Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's volatility among all stocks. Helps identify relatively calm or volatile names in the universe.

indicators.label: Sector Strength Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's sector momentum among all sectors. Shows whether the stock is in a leading or lagging sector.

indicators.label: Momentum Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's composite momentum score among all stocks. The primary cross-sectional momentum ranking metric.

indicators.label: Liquidity Pctl
indicators.description: Percentile rank of this stock's liquidity among all stocks. Ensures selected stocks are tradable relative to the full universe.

indicators.label: Min Market Cap
indicators.description: Minimum market capitalization threshold. Stocks below this are excluded to ensure institutional quality and sufficient float.

indicators.label: Min Avg Daily Value
indicators.description: Minimum average daily rupee turnover threshold. Ensures all selected stocks have enough liquidity for the intended position sizes.

indicators.label: Max Bid-Ask Spread
indicators.description: Maximum allowable bid-ask spread. Stocks with wider spreads are excluded due to excessive execution costs.

indicators.label: Max ATR %
indicators.description: Maximum allowable ATR percentage. Stocks above this threshold are excluded as too volatile for the strategy's risk parameters.

indicators.label: Min Price
indicators.description: Minimum stock price threshold. Excludes penny stocks that may have unreliable price action and poor liquidity.

indicators.label: Exclude Circuit Stocks
indicators.description: When true, stocks that are at or near circuit limits are excluded. Circuit stocks cannot be freely traded and carry execution risk.

indicators.label: Exclude Illiquid
indicators.description: When true, stocks below the liquidity threshold are excluded. Prevents taking positions that would be difficult to exit.

indicators.label: Exclude Restricted
indicators.description: When true, stocks under ASM, GSM, or other regulatory restrictions are excluded. These face additional trading constraints and margin requirements.
indicators.formula: Exclude if ASM or GSM status is true

categories.label: Scoring Weights
categories.description: Category weights for composite momentum score

indicators.label: Price Momentum Weight
indicators.description: Weight assigned to price momentum in the composite score. The primary driver capturing multi-timeframe return signals.
indicators.formula: Composite = Σ(Category_Score × Weight); this weight applies to Price Momentum

indicators.label: Relative Strength Weight
indicators.description: Weight assigned to relative strength in the composite score. Rewards stocks outperforming the market, sector, and peers.
indicators.formula: Composite = Σ(Category_Score × Weight); this weight applies to Relative Strength

indicators.label: Trend Structure Weight
indicators.description: Weight assigned to trend structure in the composite score. Ensures the stock has a well-defined pattern of higher highs and lows.
indicators.formula: Composite = Σ(Category_Score × Weight); this weight applies to Trend Structure

indicators.label: Breakout Weight
indicators.description: Weight assigned to breakout signals in the composite score. Captures stocks breaking to new highs with volume confirmation.
indicators.formula: Composite = Σ(Category_Score × Weight); this weight applies to Breakout

indicators.label: Volume Confirmation Weight
indicators.description: Weight assigned to volume-price confirmation in the composite score. Validates that price moves are backed by real trading volume.
indicators.formula: Composite = Σ(Category_Score × Weight); this weight applies to Volume Confirmation

indicators.label: Trend Quality Weight
indicators.description: Weight assigned to trend quality (efficiency, R-squared) in the composite score. Favors clean, low-noise trends.
indicators.formula: Composite = Σ(Category_Score × Weight); this weight applies to Trend Quality

indicators.label: Volatility Quality Weight
indicators.description: Weight assigned to volatility characteristics in the composite score. Penalizes excessive or erratic volatility.
indicators.formula: Composite = Σ(Category_Score × Weight); this weight applies to Volatility Quality

indicators.label: Momentum Indicator Weight
indicators.description: Weight assigned to technical momentum indicators (RSI, MACD, ADX) in the composite score. Adds confirmation from classic oscillators.
indicators.formula: Composite = Σ(Category_Score × Weight); this weight applies to Momentum Indicators

indicators.label: Fwd Return 1D
indicators.description: Actual return over the next 1 trading day. Used as a target label for ML models and to evaluate signal quality.

indicators.label: Fwd Return 3D
indicators.description: Actual return over the next 3 trading days. Short-term forward label for evaluating signal predictiveness.

indicators.label: Fwd Return 5D
indicators.description: Actual return over the next 5 trading days. A key target for weekly momentum signal evaluation.

indicators.label: Fwd Return 10D
indicators.description: Actual return over the next 10 trading days. Two-week forward target for swing trading signal evaluation.

indicators.label: Fwd Return 20D
indicators.description: Actual return over the next 20 trading days. Monthly forward target for evaluating intermediate holding periods.

indicators.label: Fwd Max Return 5D
indicators.description: Maximum return achieved at any point over the next 5 trading days. Measures the best exit opportunity within the window.

indicators.label: Fwd Max Return 10D
indicators.description: Maximum return achieved at any point over the next 10 trading days. Shows the upside capture opportunity with a trailing stop.

indicators.label: Fwd Max DD 5D
indicators.description: Worst peak-to-trough drawdown experienced over the next 5 trading days. Measures the near-term risk of holding the position.
indicators.formula: Max drawdown from Close over next 5 days

indicators.label: Fwd Max DD 10D
indicators.description: Worst peak-to-trough drawdown experienced over the next 10 trading days. Two-week forward risk measure.
indicators.formula: Max drawdown from Close over next 10 days

indicators.label: Fwd Max DD 20D
indicators.description: Worst peak-to-trough drawdown experienced over the next 20 trading days. Monthly forward risk measure for position management.
indicators.formula: Max drawdown from Close over next 20 days
